title: PASSAGE pre-start GitHub/OneDrive reconciliation
purpose: Reconcile the durable GitHub platform authority and OneDrive execution/evidence authority before PASSAGE, record PASSAGE through the existing ADR mechanism, remove stale duplicate current-state text, preserve promoted baselines, and stop without product mutation or PASSAGE implementation.

decision.verticalSlice: source → Factory → exact kit → qualification → import → runtime → learner
decision.operatingPrinciple: need/blocker → smallest correct change → smallest sufficient proof → PASS / STOP / USE

invariants: GitHub remains the authority for executable platform code, contracts, validators, runtime, Factory implementation, durable architecture, tests and product identities.
OneDrive remains the execution/evidence authority for course sources, orchestration, jobs, state logs, reviews, results and attestations.
OneDrive product evidence binds exact Git identities and does not redefine product semantics.
Promoted learner and M3.x baselines remain unchanged.
Existing pilot/V5/V6 branches and pull requests remain unmerged and unpromoted by this work package.
PASSAGE implementation is not started by this work package.
governance/governor-state.json remains the single machine-readable dynamic Git frame.
GOVERNANCE.md remains standing authority and does not duplicate phase-specific current state.
requiredEvidence: Exact changed-path inventory contains only the five allowed paths.
ADR-0004 records PASSAGE and the GitHub/OneDrive authority boundary without creating another registry or state machine.
Repository governance PASS on the exact PR head.
PR scope / gate PASS on the exact PR head.
governor-state preserves promoted baselines and distinguishes active governed draft work from promotion.
adversarialTests: Any product/runtime/Factory/contract/test mutation must fail review.
Any merge or promotion of an existing pilot/V5/V6 candidate must fail review.
Any PASSAGE implementation change must fail review.
Any new dynamic registry, roadmap or state machine must fail review.
Any changed path outside the exact five-path scope must fail review.
nonGoals: runtime, scoring, evidence, planner or Factory logic changes
existing pilot PR merge or promotion
independentReview: Repository governance independently validates the durable work-package and governor-state structure.
PR scope / gate independently binds the complete base...head diff to the exact five-path allowed scope.
The constituted LearnIT job requires a bounded PROVE_OR_REFUTE pass before terminal PASS.
rollback: Revert the five governance/documentation paths. Product/runtime/Factory/contracts/tests and all promoted artifact identities remain unchanged.
